scope: Synthetic, paid, DOM-free engine comparison. Not human win rates or tuning evidence.

concentrated-rush.lanes: Starting road only. Upgrade living production there only when every legal site on that road is occupied. Never expand to other roads.

screened-mixed-mine.lanes: Opening production on starting road; mine at rear of starting road. Repeat cycles rotate through starting road then remaining roads; no second mine.

air-and-rootwarden.lanes: Opening production on starting road. Repeat cycles rotate through starting road then remaining roads.

playerActionPolicy: Ordered sequence advances only after successful paid build. Production chooses forward-to-rear official sites. If requested road is full, mixed policies try remaining roads, then upgrade lowest-level oldest living producer at full map capacity. Rush remains one road. No player spells or salvage. Never skip an unaffordable next producer to spend on a cheaper alternative.
nativeAi: Game ai:false solely to mirror the enemy side. Invoke unchanged Game._ai(enemySide) after each fixed step when its external timer expires, initially at the first step. Set timer to 5 + game.random() * 3 seconds exactly as normal production AI. Player decisions occur before update; AI decisions after update. Both sides pay ordinary engine prices. No gold/entity/health injection.
continuation: Stop only at native winner or 600 seconds. A living match at the bound is ongoing, never a forced draw or balance failure by itself. Open-ended overtime keeps existing production and structure damage rules; no citadel decay.
observations: Every accepted/rejected paid command cost checked against ordinary engine action result; both-side ledger reconciles initial gold + base + mine + kill bounty + bridge - spending + refunds.
Every 60 seconds and at final state: strict save restore and next-step continuation comparison on independent clones, never advancing the measured game.

Every fixed step: ownership transitions, uninterrupted empty ownership durations, contested/empty times, map-wide payout bound and actual bridge receipts. Empty receipts inferred only for bridges empty in the post-step sample and owned before/after the step.
Native spawn observations count actual gryphons and Rootwardens; no unit injection.

Snapshots at 30, 60, 90, 180, 300, 420 and 600 seconds or native end. Early leader at 90 seconds means healthier own citadel; ties remain ties. Record separate payout and army-count leads without claiming causal leadership.

Paired enabled/disabled first successful build times by type/actor, first differing paid action, spending, outcomes, duration and bridge receipts. Label any affordability check subtracting cumulative bridge receipts as an all-other-recorded-actions-held-fixed ledger check, not an isolated causal simulation.
readinessChecks: Any negative/nonfinite gold, wrong price, unexplained ledger residual > 1e-6, map-wide bridge payout above 0.5 gold/second, ownership loss without enemy recapture, invalid save or divergent restored continuation is a blocker.
Report every natural outcome and adverse comparison. A large enabled-vs-disabled duration or win shift is inspected, not automatically tuned away. Reward is provisional and not claimed balanced.
Do not change seeds, policies, cap, reward or engine rules in response to desired results. Retain failed run output; a repair rerun must state why and keep original evidence.
